description: 26a: Test whether α₄ = 0.8272 (from n→p single-nucleon fit) ALSO closes tritium Q via parent-daughter NF-difference baseline (branching factorization).  Tests four ansätze: (1) frozen α₄ at various ranks, (2) raw Pochhammer no fit, (3) chirality knot + tail, (4) per-rank fitted α to find which rank gives α ≈ 0.8272 universal.
